name: Nathanos' Ruse
label: Quest
description: Nathanos' Ruse: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have made some adjustments to this command. Should our little ruse work, they will expose the Scarlet Oracle and we shall strike!
Now pay attention, adventurer. You are to deliver this command to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
How? You are going to hand it to him, imbecile.

Take the command and this rotten apple to Tyr's Hand. When you cross into the city, eat the apple. You will transform into something more... Palatable to the humans. Take the command and hand it to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Where have you been? We had thought the Scourge had captured you.
